label: Middle Cut-Away 8.5 cm
description: The Middle Cut-Away at 8.5cm combines a longer point length with the outward-angled cutaway spread, creating a collar that is both assertive and elegant. The extra length ensures the points sit correctly over the jacket lapels without curling, while the wider spread accommodates full and half-Windsor knots with ease. This collar is favoured by Continental and Neapolitan shirtmakers for its confident balance of tradition and modernity.
